objective: Before GATX-T02, establish one reusable privacy-bounded automatic diagnostic collection/export channel so pertinent system-known Alpha context is captured without tester copy/paste and a diagnostic JSON file is written on the host laptop.
owner_instruction: Make sure any pertinent information is collected automatically by the alpha and, when done, create a file on the laptop with all diagnostic information; prepare anything needed first, then continue to T02.
construction_rule: Finish the complete bounded foundation before validation; batch related validation repairs; do not fragment construction with micro-validation.
last_verified_action: Application construction is sealed on internal-alpha/gatx-diagnostics-foundation; validation has not yet begun.
next_action: Open the application PR, run the complete diagnostics-foundation validation phase, batch any related repairs, merge only after all declared gates pass, then project completed_verified and immediately activate GATX-T02.
automatic_collection: bounded JavaScript errors and unhandled rejections
bounded sanitized PowerShell runner log tail
acceptance: Pertinent system-known diagnostic information is collected automatically.
The host laptop maintains an in-progress diagnostic JSON snapshot.
Completing the Guided Alpha round writes a final diagnostic JSON file on the host laptop.
Normal runner shutdown finalizes active sessions and Save Diagnostics Now permits an immediate snapshot.
Android/trusted-LAN browser events are stored on the Windows host laptop.
Diagnostic files carry exact build/account/role/round/browser/connection/error context and explicit privacy flags.
Unknown/free-text fields, credentials and arbitrary application contents do not enter the diagnostic file.
Package and runner contracts are tranche-dynamic for T02+ reuse.
